label: input g mid-sequence in l-initial sequences containing c/x/v/w (sparse conjunction)
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.015% of steps). Fires only in the original phase at t=3..8 (mostly t=4-6) plus a little at the delimiter, never in the copy phase. Strongest enrichments: input g (17x lift, 60% of mass), first original token l (19x, 70% of mass), and preceding c/x (prev_tok, prev2_tok) or v/w earlier in the prefix. The largest activations are on g in sequences like l v w c x g. But no single conjunction captures it: the best predicate (g input, first token l, some c/x/v/w seen earlier) gets dev F1 0.23 and mass recall 0.34. Many activations fall on non-g tokens (n, d, f, x, q) in l/v-initial sequences containing c/x, and many g-after-l sequences without that context stay silent. It looks like a dense-history conjunction that does not reduce to a simple description.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=l (+6.33), orig1=v (+3.65), prev_tok=c (+3.57), orig0=k (+3.25), prev2_tok=c (+3.20), prev_tok=x (+3.18). Lower it: correct=1 (-6.53), phase=2 (-2.61), prev3_tok=- (-2.57), orig2=g (-1.80).
